description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1850/22 of 17.04.2014, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521005
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific modifications to land title records, including exclusions of encumbrances, amendments to rights of way, and expunging of particulars for various land parcels in different locations. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property rights modifications without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
